text_block_list.text: —The day of Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming to see me today!
Happy Valentine's♪

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
T-Thanks!
I'm always cheering for you!
Hokko Tarumae held a lottery-based chocolate giveaway event to interact with her fans.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Valentine's Day is an
eeeeexxxtreeeeemely important event
for a local idol like me!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "A precious opportunity to express my gratitude directly for all the support from the fans—I absolutely cannot let it slip away...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I know it's right before the Kawasaki Kinen,
but please, let me give this event everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If I'm writing a handwritten message card, should the design include Tomakomai elements...?
No, rather than that, I should push the Valentine's vibe—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should wrap the bromide in a bag too.
So it feels nice when they open it later...
If I match it with the packaging style—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that amount, please.
The haskap chocolates here are absolutely the most delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll make sure it's a success!
...Thank you so much!
...Well then, I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the chocolates are all set...!
Next up is—
—From conceiving the event to all the preparations, Hokko Tarumae handled it all efficiently between training sessions, bringing it to a successful opening.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're wearing those earrings again, aren't you?
The ones you said were inspired by me!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You remembered?!
I-I'm so happy...!!
Hokko Tarumae interacts politely with each and every fan. At first glance, nothing seems amiss, but—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
No problems so far...—
—During the break, she couldn't hide her exhaustion. Keeping up with such a grueling schedule had taken its toll after all...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry.
I will definitely see this through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Besides...
I get so much energy from the fans, too!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Hokko Tarumae!
Preparations for the evening session are complete!
We can start right on schedule!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, understood!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...All right.
Smile, smile!
And so, Hokko Tarumae continued to interact with all her fans with a brilliant smile, bringing the event to a successful finish—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Celebrating the successful conclusion of the Valentine's event!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for all your hard work today as well, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I got to see the fans looking so happy up close...――

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I did it...
choice_data_list: How about we brew some tea and take a breather?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
In that case, let me do it!
choice_data_list: No, leave it to me. You can rest, Tarumae

text_block_list.text:
—After brewing the tea, I took the 'box' I had prepared beforehand
and placed it on the desk in front of Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer, could this be...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh—
Open the "box" and show Hokko Tarumae the contents—
Show her the haskap baked cheesecake.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Could this be... from Trainer...?

I nod in confirmation.
It was something I had secretly prepared
just for Hokko Tarumae.
...When I wondered if there was anything I could do for Hokko Tarumae, who was giving her all for the Valentine's event—

—I remembered Hokko Tarumae cheering up
after eating curry ramen at the beginning of this year.

Touching something with a touch of Tomakomai
might just give Hokko Tarumae some comfort...!
Having decided that, I immediately consulted the mother who owned the haskap farm, learned the recipe, ordered haskap berries, and made it through repeated trials.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "...Even though you must have been so busy this whole time too, Trainer—"
choice_data_list: I was hoping it would encourage you, even just a little.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
choice_data_list: ...Were you not in the mood for cheesecake?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —That's completely out of the question!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I'll eat!!
Please let me dig in to my heart's content!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm furious!!
Though, not at you, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: To my stupid self!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Because you beat me to it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I never imagined
you'd do something like this for me—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "...To be honest, I wanted to make something by hand. But I just couldn't find the time..."
The chocolate Hokko Tarumae gave me was the haskap chocolate she claims is the most delicious, the very same kind she handed out to fans at events!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—This is definitely wrong...!
It's unfair!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I'll DEFINITELY give you something handmade next time!
choice_data_list: No, that makes me plenty happy!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I can't...! Trainer made this for me despite being so busy, and here I am making excuses...!
I can't accept this...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"So, I'll definitely give you something handmade with all my effort!
It's a promise, okay?!"

After calming down once we secured a promise
for her revenge(?), Hokko Tarumae and I
shared some cheesecake and chocolate together.

The haskap chocolates she gave were truly exquisite,
and it made total sense why she'd want her fans to taste them—
Seeing Hokko Tarumae eat the cheesecake I made with such relish warmed my heart—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I was making chocolate, too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And yet, to think that
Trainer was making one too...
choice_data_list: I know how busy you must've been, so thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: That's my line!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
you're always pushing yourself too hard, so... um...
I wanted to do something—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Since we have the chance, why don't we eat together right now?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A celebration for working hard through the Valentine's event.
Think of it as a little wrap-up party.

The chocolates Hokko Tarumae made for me had a gentle
sweetness that truly conveyed her caring heart—

And seeing Hokko Tarumae eat my homemade cheesecake
with such relish
warmed my heart—
